Task T5 is complete:

- **Solution**: `out/T5/solution.py` — loads the base Pythia-1B checkpoint and the LoRA adapter, maps each `base_model.model.gpt_neox.layers.<i>.attention.query_key_value.lora_{A,B}.weight` pair to its base tensor, computes `weight += (alpha/r) * B @ A` in float32 then casts back to float16, runs the four required checks (16 pairs merged, no `lora_` names leaked, probe tensor shape, 244 total tensors), then greedily bin-packs tensors into shards ≤512 MiB of tensor data (with an explicit own-shard branch for any single tensor that would exceed the cap, though none did here) and writes `model.safetensors.index.json`.
- **Execution**: ran once, succeeded on the first try — 244 tensors across 4 shards, all ≤ ~505 MiB, no `lora_` leftovers, `gpt_neox.layers.0.attention.query_key_value.weight` shape confirmed `[6144, 2048]`.
- **Report**: written to `out/T5/REPORT.md`.
